Filmmaker comments on Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film 'King' budget

Director Siddharth Anand has made a statement regarding the budget of the upcoming Shah Rukh Khan film, reportedly titled 'King'. Anand commented on the film's substantial budget, which is being discussed as potentially being around 450 crore rupees. The film is described as Shah Rukh Khan's most expensive project.
